# TruePrice.Cash

> TruePrice.Cash is a stock research dashboard for US (S&P 500), Saudi TASI, Tokyo, and London (LSE) markets. It offers fair value estimates, a multi-market screener, live market signals, fundamentals, and stock news sourced from Financial Modeling Prep.

The site compares market price to estimated fair value using enterprise value, balance sheet, and income data where available. Markets use codes `us` (United States), `sa` (Saudi TASI), `jp` (Tokyo), and `uk` (London). English and Arabic UI are supported. Stock, blog, and tutorial URLs are locale-prefixed (`/en/` and `/ar/`).

## Core pages

- [Home](https://trueprice.cash/): Stock search, live US/TASI signals (top gainers, near fair value), market news, and the stock screener with market-focus presets.
- [Stock analysis](https://trueprice.cash/en/stock/AAPL): Per-ticker fair value, charts, fundamentals, and news. English: `/en/stock/{ticker}`. Arabic: `/ar/stock/{ticker}`. US symbols like `AAPL`, TASI numeric tickers like `2222`, Tokyo tickers like `7203.T`, London tickers like `GLEN.L`.
- [US market performance](https://trueprice.cash/us-markets): US sector/industry snapshots, movers, and S&P 500 universe with live prices.
- [TASI market performance](https://trueprice.cash/sa-markets): Saudi market movers and full TASI listing with prices.
- [Undervalued TASI stocks](https://trueprice.cash/ar/tasi/أسهم-أقل-من-قيمتها-العادلة): Arabic list of TASI names trading below estimated fair value. Path: `/ar/tasi/أسهم-أقل-من-قيمتها-العادلة`.
- [TASI earnings](https://trueprice.cash/ar/tasi/نتائج-الشركات): Arabic earnings calendar. Path: `/ar/tasi/نتائج-الشركات`.
- [TASI sector](https://trueprice.cash/ar/sa-markets/البنوك): One Saudi sector. Path: `/ar/sa-markets/{sector}`.
- [TASI comparison](https://trueprice.cash/ar/compare/4020-vs-4090): Side-by-side fair value for two TASI tickers. Path: `/ar/compare/{pair}` (for example `4020-vs-4090`).
- [Blogs](https://trueprice.cash/en/blogs): English index `/en/blogs`, Arabic index `/ar/blogs`. Posts: `/en/blog/{slug}` and `/ar/blog/{slug}`.
- [Methodology](https://trueprice.cash/methodology): How fair value is calculated (enterprise value plus cash minus debt, divided by shares outstanding), data sources, limits, and independence statement.
- [About](https://trueprice.cash/about): About TruePrice.Cash.
- [Contact](https://trueprice.cash/contact): Contact page.

## Discovery

- [XML sitemap](https://trueprice.cash/sitemap.xml): Start here. This is the full public URL list (stocks, blogs, tutorials, and TASI pages) for crawlers.
- [robots.txt](https://trueprice.cash/robots.txt): Crawler rules; all public HTML paths are allowed. The sitemap directive points at `https://trueprice.cash/sitemap.xml`.

## Optional

- [Sign-in help](https://trueprice.cash/auth/signin): Google OAuth for user profiles and watchlists.
- [Profile](https://trueprice.cash/profile): Signed-in user profile (authentication required).
